==English==

===Pronunciation===

** {{audio|en|LL-Q1860 (eng)-Vealhurl-stationary.wav|a=Southern England}}
* {{enPR|stāʹshə-nĕr-ĭ|a=US}}, {{IPA|en|/ˈsteɪʃənɛɹi/}}
* {{audio|en|LL-Q1860 (eng)-Vininn126-stationery.wav|a=US}}
* {{homophones|en|stationary}}

===Etymology 1===
From {{suffix|en|stationer|y}}.
<!--Not quite true: this is the origin of "stationer", not "stationery":
From '''[[stationary]]''', as such goods were sold in shops, which are stationary, and not by travelling peddlers. Frequency data indicates that "stationary" is preferred to "stationery" for the spelling. (Wrong: "stationery" is the only accepted modern spelling; "stationary" is now obsolete)-->

====Noun====
{{en-noun|-|+}}

# [[writing|Writing]] [[materials]], [[envelope]]s, [[office]] [[material]]s.
#: {{ux|en|When the school year finished, he put all of his '''stationery''' away in the loft, as he would have no need for pencils and exercise books during the holidays.}}
#: {{ux|en|We can pick up more paper and pens at the '''stationery''' store.}}
